{{Quote|This mission is a dangerous one, but critical to the New Republic's continued existence in this sector.|[[Captain/Legends|Captain]] [[Naren Bluuis|Bluuis]]|<ref name="Counterstrike" />}}
A '''mission''' was undertook by the [[New Republic/Legends|New Republic]] in the [[Spawn Nebula/Legends|Spawn Nebula]] during the [[Galactic Civil War/Legends|Galactic Civil War]] to investigate and eliminate the [[Restored Empire|Kaarenth Dissension]] in the [[Corva sector/Legends|Corva sector]].

==Prelude==
{{Quote|As you are aware, a new Imperial faction has risen to power in Corva Sector. Though at first we thought it an extension of the Pentastar Alignment, we have recently discovered that it is an independent splinter group calling itself the Kaarenth Dissension.|Captain Bluuis|<ref name="Counterstrike" />}}
Not long after the end of the [[Thrawn campaign]], a group of [[New Republic/Legends|New Republic]] was dispatched to investigate the increased presence of the [[Restored Empire|Kaarenth Dissension]] in the [[Corva sector/Legends|Corva sector]]. On the planet [[Betha II]], the operatives identified [[Meres Ulcane]] as the leader of the Kaarenth Dissension in the sector.<ref name="Counterstrike" />

==The mission to the Spawn Nebula==
Using the experimental [[Drooim-Durtha Systems]] [[ShipFinder]] device, the New Republic operatives were able to successfully track Ulcane's vessel from Betha II to his secret base, hidden in the [[Spawn Nebula/Legends|Spawn Nebula]].<ref name="Counterstrike" /> The Kaarenth Dissension base was in fact a huge [[worldcraft]] repurposed into a repair facility and [[Shipyard/Legends|shipyard]] hub.<ref name="Despoilers" /> Moreover, the New Republic operatives discovered that the worldcraft was orbited by an entire fleet of warships, including [[Assault shuttle/Legends|assault shuttles]], [[Patrol ship/Legends|system patrol crafts]], [[Frigate/Legends|frigates]], [[Strike-class medium cruiser|''Strike''-class medium cruisers]] and one [[Imperial-class Star Destroyer/Legends|''Imperial''-class Star Destroyer]]. This secret fleet, currently without crew, had been assembled over the year to strike one day the New Republic. Following a [[Freighter/Legends|freighter]] that was heading to the space station, they were able to land their ship, the [[Instigator (RX4 Patrol Ship)|''Instigator'']], in one of the sphere's hangars. The New Republic agents successfully infiltrated the worldcraft and even managed to access the main reactor section where they planted explosives,<ref name="Counterstrike" /> namely [[illerium]].<ref name="Despoilers" /> However, the operatives were finally spotted and attacked by [[Stormtrooper/Legends|stormtroopers]]. They hastily rushed to the hangar and departed in their starship. Once in space, they were attacked by eight [[TIE/ln space superiority starfighter/Legends|TIE fighters]] but the ''Instigator'' destroyed them all. An [[Immobilizer 418 Interdictor-class Heavy Cruiser|Interdictor cruiser]] later arrived in the area but it was too late to prevent the New Republic ship to enter [[Hyperspace/Legends|hyperspace]]. The explosives planted in the worldcraft detonated at this very moment. The explosion destroyed the giant sphere and the shock wave wiped out the starships nearby.<ref name="Counterstrike" />

==Aftermath==
{{Quote|I wish to commend you on your performance in this mission. Had the Kaarenth Dissension brought its fleet to bear, we would have been doomed.|Captain Bluuis|<ref name="Counterstrike" />}}
The destruction of the Kaarenth Dissension fleet in the Spawn Nebula ruined definitively the chances of the Imperial faction to overthrow the New Republic in the Corva sector.<ref name="Counterstrike" /> The death of Meres Ulcane and the loss of most of his fleet was a severe setback for the Dissension but the use of illerium to destroy the worldcraft eventually inspired [[Ennix Devian]], the leader of the Kaarenth Dissension, his next attack against the New Republic.<ref name="Despoilers" />
